# secret Provider

Commit AES-256-GCM encrypted secrets to your repo and decrypt them on-the-fly during plan/apply, ansible-vault style. The passphrase comes from an environment variable. Decrypted values are ephemeral and never touch state or plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11" # ephemeral resources (1.10) + write-only arguments (1.11)

  required_providers {
    secret = {
      source = "szandala/secret"
    }
  }
}

# Optional: env var used by every secret_secret that doesn't set its own
# secret_key. One root module per environment -> set it once here.
provider "secret" {
  secret_key = "PROD_SECRET_KEY"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `secret_key` (String) Name of the environment variable holding the passphrase for every secret_secret that does not set its own secret_key. Defaults to "SECRET_KEY". Handy for one root module per environment, e.g. "PROD_SECRET_KEY" in the prod root.
